subscription_not_found: This business has no subscription on record.
subscription_canceled: The subscription is canceled. Reactivate it before recording a payment.
custom_price_required: A plan without a published price needs a per-client agreed price.
reactivation_window_over: The paid period is over: reactivation happens through a new payment.
discount_overlap: There is already an active discount for this business. Revoke it before granting another.
